purpose: Isolate why full = line5 + T01 + B-only does not equal B-only even though line5 and T01 decrypt to zero individually. This probes add_coeff_ct identity behavior on raw-imported coefficient ciphertexts.

summary.if_add_zero_fails: A term that decrypts to zero is not an algebraic zero for add_coeff_ct. Use raw RNS coefficient addition for Algorithm 3 line6 instead of OpenFHE EvalAdd on raw-imported debug handles.
summary.if_order_differs: If B+zero differs from zero+B, add path has metadata/order dependence.
summary.if_all_pass: Then X7i full mismatch came from script assembly, not add_coeff_ct; inspect X7i full construction.
summary.zh: X7j 用于判断 line6 是否必须改成 raw coefficient add，而不能使用 add_coeff_ct。
